usedFor: Fathom captures meeting notes, and MSG91 sends the mail when “New Action Item” runs “Send a Mail” from a template.

bestTemplate.name: “New Action Item” in Fathom, then “Send a Mail” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: Each action item from a meeting goes out as a templated mail through your MSG91 account.

watchOut: A mail that reaches someone outside your business waits in Needs you until you approve it.
